index.css net-zero padding+negative-margin technique on .mini-btn, .event-card-btn, .add-calendar-link works well: all 5 requested tap targets now measure 36.5-37.25px height (>=32px requirement met) with zero visual footprint change (background transparent, only border-bottom/underline visible, no box shape), confirmed on both Home preview cards AND the /events grid (all 26 EventCard buttons use the same shared class so fix applies globally).
No horizontal overflow, no overlaps, no layout shift detected on any of the 4 pages x 3 breakpoints (12 combinations) tested.

EventsPreview 2x2 grid confirmed via computed grid-template-columns ('348px 348px' at 1440px = 2 cols, single '327px' column at 375px = 1 col), 4 featured cards render correctly (Slam Poetry, Tamasha, BioFlix, Rhythm Revolution), and 'View all 26 events' text is correctly dynamic.
